_note: Registry of universities a question or feedback note can come from (field origin_universities, a list of these slugs). Sponsors supply university-specific material, so the dataset records where each item came from. Only the founder adds entries. A question with no origin_universities is general NUC CCMAS-level material, not tied to one university. Never label a question with a university unless that university's material was its source.
